name: Sarecycline

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS The use of SEYSARA during tooth development (second and third trimesters of pregnancy, infancy, and childhood up to the age of 8 years) may cause permanent discoloration of the teeth (yellow-gray-brown). ( 5.1 ) If Clostridium difficile Associated Diarrhea (antibiotic associated colitis)…

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, found a high risk score for the liver and a low risk score for the heart [M]. Official warnings state that using the drug during tooth development—specifically the second and third trimesters of pregnancy, infancy, and childhood up to age 8—can permanently stain teeth yellow, gray, or brown [3]. The label also notes a warning sign for severe diarrhea linked to an infection called Clostridium difficile, which is swelling of the colon caused by antibiotics [3].
